storylines.text: Munetaka Murakami is running hot right now, hitting well above his 0.257 season average over his last games with at least one home run in that stretch. He faces NYY sends out Cam Schlittler today, in a park that plays up for power, a pitcher who's allowed a 0.200 average against this season.

Yordan Alvarez is running hot right now, hitting well above his 0.338 season average over his last games with at least one home run in that stretch. He faces LAA sends out Grayson Rodriguez today, in a pitcher-friendly park, a pitcher who's allowed a 0.323 average against this season.

Junior Caminero is in a real home run drought — none in his last 10 games — but the underlying indicators haven't cooled the same way: a .231 ISO and a 0.923 OPS this season say the power is still there, it just hasn't landed yet. TEX sends out MacKenzie Gore today, in a pitcher-friendly park.

He faces CWS sends out Davis Martin today, in a park that plays up for power, a pitcher who's allowed a 0.257 average against this season. This pitcher has also been genuinely tougher to hit hard once he gets to two strikes this season, not just generically good.
